---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Lil' Agents Windows.
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g., *"I find it difficult to move agents across monitors when using multiple screens"* or *"I want agents to respond to voice queries using TTS"*).

## Describe the Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision it working.

## Technical Design / Implementation Ideas (Optional)
If you have programming suggestions or layout designs in mind (e.g., C# class updates in `DesktopAgentForm.cs` or new properties in `AgentConfig.cs`).

## Use Cases & Visual Mockups
Describe the workflow or draw a simple mockup showing how you expect the UI to change.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A description of any alternative workarounds or designs you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, visual links, or references about the feature request here.
